name: Murder Monkey
summary:
🔪 Can you solve the mystery and survive?

Every round you get a secret role. Find out who the Murderer is... before it's too late!

🟢 INNOCENT
Run, hide and grab coins 🪙
Figure out who the Murderer is!

🔵 SHERIFF
You have the gun 🔫
Shoot the Murderer. But if you shoot an innocent, you go down too!

🔴 MURDERER
You have the knife 🔪
Get EVERYONE. Don't get shot!

🦸 HERO
If the Sheriff goes down, an Innocent can grab the gun and save the day!

✨ WHAT'S IN IT
